_about: GROUPS_8 (2026-11-03, TRAIN_PLAN_1103.md; needs LEGEND_EXT=1, which makes the new events legend events): GROUPS_7 plus the forms of 2026-11-02. help: a new world (one event, the help question; it answers, it never draws): its leads (how do I, can I, what kinds of) precede words of every other world, so it is told apart by the question form, not by the topic. layout: a new world of the ten whole-diagram operations of HIGH_LEVEL_OPS.md (improve, respace, snap, fit, flip, sort, groupBy, equalize, straighten, untangle), which share their roles (a target that is mostly everything + one value: axis, comparison, property, distance, superlative). reverse joins links (an arrow named by its ends, the roles of disconnect). Templates and free text are values of create (shapes) and arrange (position); arrow restyle (set / resize from= to= or kind=edge) stays in shapes, arrow labels (label from= to=, label="") in manage, property=label of an arrow in questions. Measured with action_confusion.py on the new folders (synth_rules*, ops_formulations, opus_ext_1, synth_combo; 4716 test requests, 51 events): the ops are confused with set / resize (equalize/set 5, equalize/resize 3, straighten/set 3) and among themselves (improve/fit, improve/untangle, snap/fit) more than with the position events (4 in all); confusions inside one group: this grouping 57.7%, ops inside position 60.7% (8 of 272 more). The new world keeps position at 7 events (a smaller world fits its data better, MICRO_ROUND1.md) at the cost of those 8 cross-world cases, which the router's top-3 candidates read anyway. group / ungroup / members / groupOf (synth_rules_ops) stay in no world (DIAGRAM_OPS is off, as in the shipped chain).
